coverage.evaluation: Cervical access, uterine cavity sounding and pregnancy/IUD/infection restrictions reviewed only for named RUMI II and older VCare generations; other model IFUs remain.
coverage.treatment: Benign TLH/TAH and uterine-preserving hysteropexy separated from post-hysterectomy vault delineation; no universal device preference established.
coverage.numbers: Pan nine-cadaver landmark ranges scoped; Husslein 91-person 2 vs 6 minute endpoint, Baradwan 340-person biased RCT synthesis, Melnyk LCA/cost and Zorzato/Nagase oncologic HRs checked at stated access levels.
coverage.doseDeviceSafety: RUMI II UMH650 handle restrictions and old VCare 7–10 mL air, 5-mm access, <4-cm depth and ruptured-balloon stop are model-specific; current VCare Plus and RUMI tip/cup IFUs open.
coverage.anatomyTechnique: Trans-cervical manipulator differentiated from myoma screw, vaginal delineator from intrauterine tip; ureter distances are cadaveric surrogate, not clinical injury prevention.
coverage.followUp: Older VCare IFU inspection for perforation/bleeding after uterine preservation read; no longitudinal surgical outcome claim closed.
coverage.importedDataFigures: No page imported data/local figure; SUFU external video not viewed. Manufacturer figure labels and Melnyk captions read but image pixels/supplements not interpreted.
coverage.references: All 19 inherited references and video preserved, corrected Baradwan print citation, added two manufacturer IFUs; full-text packages for several sources outstanding.
coverage.currency: 2026 publication date/abstracts and current CONMED FAQ checked; 2016 VCare IFU explicitly historical and current Plus IFU outstanding. No new OpenEvidence pull.

claimChecks.claim: Universal Hegar 8–10 dilation, saline balloon inflation and generic contraindications
claimChecks.locator: RUMI II handle English p 1 precautions/contraindications and p 2 positioning; VCare English pp 1–2 insertion/cautions/warnings; CONMED FAQ insertion
claimChecks.note: RUMI II Hegar/Hank 8 and select tip <= sounded depth; older VCare conditional 5-mm access and 7–10 mL AIR, ruptured balloon stop; current Plus IFU still needed.

claimChecks.claim: Manipulator universally protects ureter by changing distance 1.4–1.9 cm to 2.2–6.2 cm
claimChecks.locator: Pan detailed institutional abstract: 9 cadavers, three different landmarks and six positions
claimChecks.note: Inherited range mixed uterine isthmus and vaginal fornix landmarks and implied clinical ureter protection; scoped to VCare Plus cadaveric surrogate.

claimChecks.claim: Hysteropexy, post-hysterectomy vault repair and supracervical hysterectomy all use the same intrauterine colpotomy configuration
claimChecks.locator: RUMI II handle indications, older VCare supracervical precaution and CONMED DX FAQ
claimChecks.note: Distinguished uterine-preserving intrauterine access from cuff-only vaginal delineation; device and operation must be matched.

claimChecks.claim: TAH manipulator proven broadly necessary and 2025 final citation
claimChecks.locator: Baradwan 2026 primary abstract: four RCTs/340, selection/endpoint and lack-of-blinding bias
claimChecks.note: Preserved results with population/bias qualification; print citation updated to 2026; full forest plots still open.

claimChecks.claim: Reusable device has 2.4–4.2x lower GWP and minor clinical-performance differences
claimChecks.locator: Melnyk full accessible main text methods, results, Figure 3/5 captions and discussion
claimChecks.note: 2.39x/4.24x specific disposables and $16k–43k model savings scoped; LCA did not compare clinical performance.

claimChecks.claim: Zorzato null p=.05 proves no oncologic harm, and benign manipulator use has no safety issue
claimChecks.locator: Zorzato abstract recurrence HR 1.52 (0.99–2.33), OS 1.07; Nagase indexed abstract unadjusted DFS 1.18
claimChecks.note: Uncertainty explicitly retained; cancer survival cannot be transferred to benign operations, whereas perforation/bleeding still apply.

claimChecks.claim: Hohl/Clermont-Ferrand/Colpo-Probe IFU geometry, thermal injury and manipulator-caused cuff-dehiscence rates
claimChecks.locator: Husslein primary RCT abstract 49 vs 42 patients, insertion and thermal-damage endpoints
claimChecks.note: RCT supports Hohl shorter insertion but not device-attributable cuff-dehiscence incidence; need current model IFUs and full paper before specification/outcome clearance.
